_what_this_is: Deterministic channel spec table (PRD DR-7). Channel dimensions, durations and file formats are FACTS, not creative decisions. The creative-shadow model SELECTS rows from this table and cites the row id; it NEVER generates a spec value. Every spec-shaped token in a creative brief must appear here byte-for-byte — that is the Tier-4 machine check.
